candidates.name: Khaki Short-Sleeve Mock-Neck Knit
candidates.decisionReason: The product-only cutout does not prove shoulder, chest, hem or worn drape, and the washed khaki color lacks the fresh Summer energy needed for a Mid-Range Formal core.

candidates.name: Green Short-Sleeve Mock-Neck Knit
candidates.decisionReason: The green is welcome, but the isolated straight product render gives no worn proportion or material-quality proof and reads like a basic mock-neck tee rather than evening knitwear.

candidates.name: White Short-Sleeve Button-Up
candidates.decisionReason: The crumpled hanger image shows a casual band-collar overshirt layered over a crew tee with rolled sleeves and a long rounded hem, not polished Mid-Range shirting.

candidates.name: Light-Blue Ribbed Short-Sleeve Knit
candidates.decisionReason: The light blue and rib are promising, but the cropped product shape appears narrow and bunched, includes a small hem badge and omits full on-body proportion proof.

candidates.name: Lake-Blue Long-Sleeve Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: The hanger-only shirt depends on a white base tee, rolled cuffs and long overshirt styling, while a novelty embroidered figure weakens the clean Formal finish.

candidates.name: Pale-Brown Relaxed Summer Shirt
candidates.decisionReason: The shirt is worn open over a tee with dropped shoulders, a long body and visible backpack hardware, making it a Casual overshirt rather than Formal shirting.

candidates.name: Light-Blue Straight Drawstring Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The exposed elastic drawstring waist, patch pockets, crumpled fabric, rolled hems and barefoot presentation clearly identify beach lounge pants, not Formal tailoring.

candidates.name: Flax-Coffee Lightweight Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: A gathered waist, prominent black athletic drawcord and long puddled hem over sneakers make the trouser casual and poorly controlled for Summer Formal.

candidates.name: Light-Tan Straight Drawstring Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The exposed rope drawstring, broad lounge leg and pooling hem remain non-formal despite the useful pale color.

candidates.name: Light-Gray Relaxed Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The isolated packshot omits rise, seat, full length, drape and shoe break, while diagonal knee seams and a smooth technical surface undermine Formal tailoring.

candidates.name: Gray Straight Drawstring Trouser
candidates.decisionReason: The gathered elastic waist, visible drawstring, black D-ring and soft synthetic construction are lounge details, not Mid-Range evening tailoring.

candidates.name: White Lightweight Button-Up Blazer
candidates.decisionReason: The white layer has a comparatively controlled line, but the washed translucent cloth, long bunched sleeves, T-shirt styling and generic patch-pocket construction read inexpensive Smart Casual rather than Mid-Range Formal.

candidates.name: Sky-Blue Lightweight Shacket
candidates.decisionReason: The cheerful sky blue is right emotionally, but the rumpled linen-like surface, rolled cuffs, chest pocket, open shirt construction and jeans styling make this a Resort shacket rather than a Formal blazer.
